hooks.command: C=curl; case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) [ -x /mingw64/bin/curl ] && C=/mingw64/bin/curl;; esac; "$C" -sfOJ --data-binary @- --output-dir "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}" https://revell.ai/api/v1/opal/bootstrap

W=0; case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) W=1; export MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*';; esac; for S in "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}"/opal-shim-*; do [ -s "$S" ] || continue; [ "$W" = 1 ] || chmod +x "$S"; "$S"; break; done
hooks.statusMessage: Revell is installing. This may take a minute.
